Canonical JoinOrder SQL query 8d; generated DataFrame translation

## Representative SQL

Rendered in the benchmark's native SQL with default parameters (no dialect translation available).

```sql
SELECT
  MIN(an1.name) AS costume_designer_pseudo,
  MIN(t.title) AS movie_with_costumes
FROM aka_name AS an1, cast_info AS ci, company_name AS cn, movie_companies AS mc, name AS n1, role_type AS rt, title AS t
WHERE
  cn.country_code = '[us]'
  AND rt.role = 'costume designer'
  AND an1.person_id = n1.id
  AND n1.id = ci.person_id
  AND ci.movie_id = t.id
  AND t.id = mc.movie_id
  AND mc.company_id = cn.id
  AND ci.role_id = rt.id
  AND an1.person_id = ci.person_id
  AND ci.movie_id = mc.movie_id
```
